description: Defines the HpackWholeEntryBuffer class, which implements an HPACK header entry decoder that handles entries possibly split across multiple buffers, providing callbacks for each entry. It manages string size limits, error detection, and listener notifications within HTTP/2 header decoding.

classes.name: HpackWholeEntryBuffer
classes.description: A class that decodes HPACK header entries, handling entries split across multiple buffers, with callback mechanisms and error detection.
